Paragraph: "Oh, highly fortunate Rama, affirm fearlessness to me from Vali by who I am highly intimidated, and as to how there will be fearlessness to me from him, it will be apt of you to accomplish that, that way...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Explicitly asking for protection and liberation from a terrifying threat.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva pleads with Rama to grant him abhaya (fearlessness) against Vali.
Outcome/Resolution: Directly requests the primary intervention needed to restore his life.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Fear: Pleading for relief from chronic terror

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Asking the protector for abhaya, the supreme gift of freedom from fear.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Directly articulating a need for psychological safety and protection from a perceived abuser.
